concepts.name: defaultdict factories
concepts.description: collections.defaultdict calls a factory to create a missing value automatically, which is useful when grouping or accumulating.

concepts.name: Counter and most_common
concepts.description: collections.Counter counts hashable values and most_common(n) returns the n most frequent element-count pairs.

concepts.name: deque for FIFO queues
concepts.description: collections.deque supports O(1)-style appends and pops from both ends and is a natural in-memory FIFO queue.

concepts.name: dict.setdefault grouping
concepts.description: dict.setdefault(key, default) returns the existing value or inserts and returns the provided default when the key is absent.

concepts.name: min/max with key and default
concepts.description: min() and max() accept key= for comparison logic, and the single-iterable form can accept default= for empty input.

concepts.name: any/all with generator expressions
concepts.description: any() short-circuits when an item is truthy, while all() short-circuits when an item is falsy; generator expressions avoid building a temporary list.

concepts.name: dict.get defaults
concepts.description: dict.get(key, default) reads a value without raising KeyError and returns the supplied default when the key is absent.

concepts.name: str.partition for one split
concepts.description: str.partition(sep) always returns a three-tuple: text before the separator, the separator itself, and text after it.

concepts.name: removeprefix/removesuffix
concepts.description: str.removeprefix(prefix) and removesuffix(suffix) remove an exact affix when present without treating the argument as a set of characters.

concepts.name: Set difference and intersection
concepts.description: Set operators express membership relationships directly: & for intersection, | for union, - for difference, and ^ for symmetric difference.

users_by_team = defaultdict({{answer}})
